elements.text:
A magician wandering the wilds will gather far more herbs than a satchel can hold /bplants/z, leaves, saplings, dried and crushed herbs, pulps and pastes.

  The /bHerb Pouch/z is the herbalist's neat trick: a soft dyed pouch that holds only living things you have picked. Craft one as shown, dye it like leather, and right-click to open it.

  Put it on your /bBelt/z and it rides on your hip; press the /bbelt key/z to open it while it is worn. It sits just as well in the /bCharm slot/z, where the /bcharm key/z opens it instead. Each key reaches only its own slot.

 The pouch is /bdyeable/z like leather armor.
